item.title: Bridge collapse in Wheeling
item.description: Oak Hill, WV (WOAY) – Three people were injured when a bridge collapsed in Wheeling today. First responders say the bridge stretches over Wheeling Creek. It has been closed since December for a replacement project. The three people on the bridge are construction workers. One serious injury and two non-life-threatening injuries were reported.
